senses.gloss: (b. h.) to cut a gap; to squeeze into a gap; to prick. Part. pass. חָרוּק, f. חֲרוּקָה; pl. חֲרוּקִים, חֲרוּקוֹת

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 12:8">Par. XII, 8</cite> <he>החרוקות</he> (Var. <he>החֲדוּקוֹת</he>) those handles which are squeezed into holes, opp. <he>הקדוחות</he> bored handles; <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 12:17">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 11:17">XI</cite>), 17 <he>אף הרוק וצואה וכ׳</he> (read: <he>אף החרוקות</he> · <he>צואה וכ׳</he>).
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: [to set at edge,] (with שֵׁן) to gnash, grind the teeth.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 37:1">Pesik. R. s. 37</cite> <he>מְחָרְקִין שיניהם</he> ground their teeth (in sneer).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>; Tanḥ. Vaëra 6 <he>התחיל מְחָרֵק עליהם וכ׳</he> he began to gnash his teeth against them (in rage).
